title: Dynamical phase selection controls compute scaling in looped transformers
abstract: arXiv:2608.26556v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A looped transformer performs inference by iterating a weight-tied map, making its computation a dynamical process whose cost is set by the resulting inference dynamics. Here we show that networks with identical architecture and objective, trained to identical accuracy, nevertheless realize distinct dynamical phases depending strongly on initialization, and that the bifurcation defining each phase determines how test-time compute scales. The phases are distinguished by their bifurcation mechanisms, including a saddle-node fold and a Neimark-Sacker-type transition to bounded nonstationary motion. In the fold phase, a one-dimensional normal-form reduction predicts both the relaxation-time and spectral-gap amplitudes from local derivatives of the trained map, yielding the parameter-free relation $\tau(\varepsilon)[1-\lambda_{\max}(-\varepsilon)]\to\pi$. translated_title: 循环变压器中的动力学相选择控制计算扩展
translated_abstract: 循环变压器通过迭代权重共享的映射来进行推理，使其计算成为一个动力学过程，其成本由由此产生的推理动力学决定。在这里，我们展示了具有相同架构和目标、训练到相同精度的网络，却因初始化的强烈影响而实现不同的动力学相，并且定义每个相的分岔决定了测试时计算如何扩展。这些相通过其分岔机制来区分，包括鞍结折叠和到有界非平稳运动的Neimark-Sacker型转变。在折叠相中，一维正规形约化从训练映射的局部导数预测了弛豫时间和谱隙幅度，从而得到无参数关系$\tau(\varepsilon)[1-\lambda_{\max}(-\varepsilon)]\to\pi$。结合问题难度的规则分布，相同的临界慢化现象...
tldr: 本文揭示了循环变压器中，相同架构和精度的网络因初始化不同而呈现不同的动力学相，其分岔机制决定了推理时计算扩展的规律，并提出了一个无参数关系来预测这一行为。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that looped transformers with identical architecture and accuracy can exhibit distinct dynamical phases depending on initialization, where the bifurcation mechanism determines test-time compute scaling, and proposes a parameter-free relation to predict this behavior.
